title: Kilimanjaro vs Everest Base Camp: Which Trek Suits You?
excerpt: Kilimanjaro or Everest Base Camp? Both are high, iconic treks, but they differ in altitude, duration, culture and comfort.
body:
Many trekkers weigh up Kilimanjaro against Everest Base Camp (EBC) in Nepal. They are both bucket-list treks, but the experience is quite different.

## Altitude

Kilimanjaro's summit is 5,895 m. EBC sits at about 5,364 m, and the nearby viewpoint Kala Patthar is around 5,600 m. Kilimanjaro takes you higher, faster.

## Duration

A Kilimanjaro climb takes six to nine days. EBC usually takes about twelve to fourteen days return from Lukla. EBC gives more time to acclimatise; Kilimanjaro is shorter but harder on the body.

## Summit day

Kilimanjaro has a tough night ascent to the summit. EBC has no single summit day of that intensity, but many long days.

## Sleeping

On Kilimanjaro you camp (except Marangu). On EBC you sleep in teahouses with simple rooms.

## Scenery and culture

EBC is all about the Himalayas and Sherpa culture in villages along the trail. Kilimanjaro is a solitary volcano with five climate zones and wide African views. There are no villages on the mountain itself.

## Combining

Kilimanjaro combines easily with a [safari](/blog/kilimanjaro-and-safari-combined/) and the [beach](/blog/kilimanjaro-and-zanzibar/). That makes it an easy trip of two weeks.

## Which is for you?

If you have limited time and want a summit, choose Kilimanjaro. If you want a long trek through villages, choose EBC. [Plan your Kilimanjaro climb](/travel-proposal/).
